To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of 2% of nanotubes to a polymeric matrix provokes a percolation of the nanotubes, which is detected by electrical conductivity measurements, but this percolation network is not stable and is destroyed during solidification of the polymer.

the addition of MWCNT to PP, in the molten and solid states, induces a percolation of the electrical conductivity, and that the electrical conductivity is not preserved after the crystallization of the nanocomposites, because ionic conductivity disappears.
MWCNTs do not modify the crystalline structure of PP, and the rheological properties of the melt and the electrical conductivity of the solid-state are influenced by the presence of MWCNT.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the influence of MWCNT on PP properties, in the liquid state and in the solid-state.
a simple procedure of elaboration of nanocomposites and with the effect of the nanotubes on the liquid-state properties and on the crystallization process.
the influence of MWCNT on the crystallinity and the electrical conductivity of MWCNT/ PP nanocomposites, as well as with the influence of crystallization on these properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MWCNTs are not compatible with PP, but a hindering effect of MWCNPs on polymer chains is observed.
the employed manufacturing procedure does not allow the formation of stable MWCNT/ PP nanocomposites, but it is a simple and fast way to obtain a first approximation to nanotube/PP nanocomposite.
MWCNTs do not interact with PP chains, and therefore the MWCNTs are not well dispersed in the polymer matrix.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in the limit concentration of percolation (2% MWCN), the nanotubes network is destroyed during the cooling process, and the electrical properties of the nanocomposite in the solid state are not improved with respect to the pristine polymer.
the nanocomposites are not very well elaborated by the melt mixing method, because the MWCNT/ PP interaction is weak.

MWCNT/ PP nanocomposites are not suitable for electrical conductivity applications, but the simple melt-mix procedure is a good way to elaborate MWCMT/PP nanocomposite materials with a good dispersion of MWCNT, with a low concentration of nanotubes and with good mechanical properties, which could be used in other applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a melt-mixing procedure can be successfully applied to prepare nanotube/polymer nanocomposites without compatibilizer.
, even in the absence of chemical modification, MWCNT/ PP nanocomposites can be elaborated using a simple method, which can be applied in industrial scale.
the electrical conductivity of MWCNT/ PP nanocomposites can be tuned by the manufacturing procedure and the crystallization kinetics.
